dax-highlight · demo

The blocks below use <pre><code class="language-dax">. The highlightAll() call at the bottom finds and colorizes them. 

// Total sales (with blank guard)
Total Sales :=
VAR _salesRows = COUNTROWS( 'Sales' )
RETURN
    IF (
        _salesRows = 0,
        BLANK(),
        SUMX( 'Sales', 'Sales'[Quantity] * 'Sales'[Unit Price] )
    )
/* YoY growth vs previous year */
YoY Growth % :=
VAR _current  = [Total Sales]
VAR _previous = CALCULATE( [Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR( 'Date'[Date] ) )
RETURN
    DIVIDE( _current - _previous, _previous )
